A Letter For You

My Poriiii (Anaya), 💗 Happy Birthday, my love! On your special day, I just want to remind you how precious you are. You’re not just someone I love; you’re my favourite person to talk to, my soft place in a busy world, and a reason behind so many of my smiles. I hope this new year brings you peaceful mornings, dreams that come true, confidence in every step, and happiness that stays even after the candles go out. Whenever life feels difficult, I hope you remember how strong, kind, and wonderful you are. If I could give you one thing, it would be the ability to see yourself through my eyes—then you’d understand why you’re so special to me. Keep smiling, keep shining, and never forget that you deserve a love as lovely as your heart. Today is all about you, Poriiii. Make a wish, eat extra cake, and let the world spoil you a little. 🎂💕

Happy Birthday, My Love! ♡

Always yours,
Kashfi ♡
